source_text: RETRACT still hasn't got an IBOL label in the legend.  There's an x with an up-to-the-right arrow that would work for RETRACT.  In the actual Chipwits game it is the 4th icon on the 2nd row in the Operators panel.

reply_text:
Found it: the X with an up-right arrow is in the bottom row of the game's own chip-icon file. I'm cutting it out and adding it to the retract row.㊥ Gist: Retract now has the X with the up-right arrow in the legend. It's published on the turns page (futon3 `1646355`), so all four new rows now have a chip. Retract notes in the feed get the same icon.

㊢ (where the icon came from) It's not on the 1984 sheets the other chips were cut from. On the Workshop panel in `CW_Coding_Screen.png`, the 4th icon on row 2 is the minus sign. I found it in the game's own icon file, `chipwits-native/data/IBOL` (160×160, 1-bit), in the bottom row. I cut it to the same 15-pixel black-on-transparent format as `chips/op-x-arrow.png`.

㊬ (what I checked) I rendered `feed.html` in headless Chromium: the chip loads (HTTP 200) and the row reads "X AND ARROW". clj-kondo is clean, and the release build has 0 warnings.

㊟ (labels still unchecked) As with the other three, "X AND ARROW" describes the picture, not the IBOL operator's name or meaning. I haven't checked that against the game or the manual.

previous_reply_acts.text: (where the chips came from) The page's 20 chips didn't include any of these, so I cut them from `chipwits-forth/mac/graphics/IBOL_Graphics.png`. That's the same sheet the existing chips match: op-plus is found there pixel for pixel. They're in the same format as the others, black on transparent and 15 pixels wide. They're named `op-move`, `op-door` and `op-loop`, and they sit in the published `chips/` directory next to the others. Like the other chips, they're not in any repo.

The manual PDFs are in `chipwits-forth/docs` if you want the rows to give the IBOL meaning.
